description: Hybrid YouTube Data API + Analytics API + Studio Innertube creator analytics CLI with offline SQLite, framework-audit, retention/CTR/demographics commands, and competitor watchlist.

auth_env_var_specs.name: YT_STUDIO_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
auth_env_var_specs.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID from your Google Cloud Console Desktop Client

auth_env_var_specs.name: YT_STUDIO_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
auth_env_var_specs.description: OAuth 2.0 Client Secret from your Google Cloud Console Desktop Client

novel_features.name: Framework audit
novel_features.description: Cross-check whether a published video hits the Signal / Belief-Shift / Action-CTA structure by joining retention buckets against script lines from your local content directory.

novel_features.name: Retention curve
novel_features.description: Return the 100-bucket retention curve for a video as JSON or an ASCII sparkline, with the three sharpest drops auto-annotated.

novel_features.name: Retention cohort
novel_features.description: Average retention across videos whose title matches a regex (build-guide cohort vs rework cohort vs tier-list cohort).

novel_features.name: CTR decay
novel_features.description: Compare first-72h CTR to day-30 CTR for a video; flags fast-decaying thumbnails.

novel_features.name: Watchlist benchmark
novel_features.description: Compare own channel against the watchlist on CTR, retention, or upload cadence — normalized scale across all channels.

novel_features.name: Title pattern mining
novel_features.description: Token-level analysis of words/phrases that correlate with above-median CTR (winners) or below-median (losers).

novel_features.name: Idea gap
novel_features.description: Topics the watchlist covered in the last N days that the own channel has not.

novel_features.name: Watchlist suggest
novel_features.description: Auto-discover competitor channels for the watchlist via Search API; ranks by relevance and recent upload volume.

novel_features.name: Hybrid quota-aware sync
novel_features.description: Incremental sync of own channel + watchlist with daily-quota budgeting; caps concurrency and prefers cache.
